prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Houston, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1433; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving home through Houston on a weekday afternoon when the car in front of me stopped suddenly, and I braked as hard as I could. The vehicle coming the other way drifted across the center line and struck the front of my car in a low-speed head-on collision. Neither airbag deployed, and both cars could still be driven from the scene until they were towed. Within a few hours my neck and upper back began to ache, and by the next morning I had stiffness and pain that made turning my head difficult. I have described the events the same way to the officer, to the adjuster, and to my doctor. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed.
